slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
她的女儿是我大学同学！！
好一会，陈阳才勉强压下心头的惊涛骇浪。
目光重新回到迈巴赫副驾驶座上。
座位上斜倚着的女人带着婴儿肥，肌肤胜雪，裙子被扯得凌乱。
肩颈处还种了草莓，正是方才他留下的。
他怎么都没法将眼前这具慵懒又妩媚的躯体，和想象中同学刘冰冰雍容华贵的母亲联系一块。
几个小时前，他到玉珠酒店面试司机。
刚被告知司机岗位已招满，转身就撞上这个浑身酒气的女人。
只见她穿着剪裁得体的香奈儿套装，身材凹凸有致，丰满雪白而有韵味，一双含雾的桃花眼直勾勾地盯着他。
她央求着说要他代驾，而且给他双倍钱。
她声音又软又糯。
陈阳本就心灰意冷，看她脚步虚浮不像坏人，便点了头。
谁曾想刚出车，女人娇躯就像没骨头似的靠过来。
她身上那股香香的味道极具侵略性，结合柔软微胖的身子，他几次想推都推不开。
最后女人说要到半山腰看风景，他鬼使神差地将车开到这半山腰上。
刚停稳车，她就扑了上来。
他一阻再阻，最终还是兄弟不争气。
此刻，副驾驶座上的女人满脸红晕看他：“看什么呢，是不是还没尽兴？”
陈阳猛地回神，耳尖瞬间烧得通红，忙不迭地别过脸：“不是……”
女人轻笑一声，“其实你也不要误会，阿姨我其实不是随便的女人。”

“前面我们发生那事，主要是我那闺蜜黑心肝，居然在酒里给我下药。”
“好在我反应快，也刚好遇到你帮忙，不然今天我肯定要栽在她手上。”
“原来是这样，难怪你……”陈阳又忍不住偷偷瞥了她一眼，女人的五官精致得如同妖精一般，眉眼间和刘冰冰有七分相似。
却比刘冰冰多了几分成熟女人的风情。
肌肤保养的光滑水嫩，看起来也就三十岁模样。
也难怪刘冰冰能和他女友柳娇娇同是大学校花。
他会认出对方是刘冰冰的亲妈，全是半小时前她接的那个电话。
当时她手机屏幕亮起，他瞄了眼，来电显示女儿，背景是刘冰冰穿着学士服的照片。
那是大学毕业典礼上，他和女友柳娇娇还凑过去跟刘冰冰合过影。
刘傲菲这时从随身的名牌手包里抽出一沓现金，直接塞进他怀里：“这钱你拿着，今天的事，绝不能有第三个人知道。”
陈阳却像被烫到一样，立刻把钱递了回去：“阿姨，我不能要你的钱，你放心，这事我会烂在肚子里，绝不会对任何人说。”
他虽然家境普通，但也知道不能乱要人家的钱。
刘傲菲皱了皱眉，又把钱塞过去：“你不收下，我不安心，就当是我给你的代驾费。”
她顿了顿，补充道，“送我回去吧，一会我女儿可就要找来了。”
陈阳本还想拒绝，听到这话不免有点紧张：“你女儿会找到这来？”
“她在我车上装有定位器，要找我，随时也能找到。”
“那我这就送你回去。”陈阳吓出冷汗，手忙脚乱地系上安全带。
要是被刘冰冰撞见他和她妈在车上，说不定就会看出什么。
到时他就算有一百张嘴也说不清了。
刘傲菲报了个地址，他把车开出。

半小时后，车子驶入凤鸣居。
content_en:
Her daughter is my college classmate! !
After a while, Chen Yang managed to suppress the turmoil in his heart.
His eyes returned to the passenger seat of the Maybach.
The woman reclining on the seat had baby fat, her skin was as thick as snow, and her skirt was torn to pieces.
There are also strawberries planted on the shoulders and necks, which he left just now.
He couldn't connect the lazy and charming body in front of him with the graceful and luxurious mother of his imaginary classmate Liu Bingbing.
A few hours ago, he went to Yuzhu Hotel to interview a driver.
As soon as I was told that the driver position was full, I turned around and bumped into this woman who smelled of alcohol.
She was wearing a well-tailored Chanel suit, with a curvy figure, plump, white and charming, and a pair of misty peach blossom eyes staring straight at him.
She begged and asked him to drive for her and give him double the money.
Her voice was soft and waxy.
Chen Yang was already disheartened, but seeing that her steps were sloppy and didn't look like a bad person, he nodded.
Who would have thought that as soon as he got out of the car, the woman's delicate body would lean over as if she had no bones.
The fragrant smell on her body was extremely aggressive, and combined with her soft and chubby body, he couldn't push her away even if he tried to push her.
Finally, the woman said she wanted to go to the mountainside to see the scenery, and he drove the car halfway up the mountain by mistake.
As soon as the car stopped, she rushed forward.
He blocked it again and again, but in the end the brothers failed to live up to their expectations.
At this moment, the woman in the passenger seat looked at him with a blushing face: "What are you looking at? Are you not enjoying yourself yet?"
Chen Yang suddenly came back to his senses, the tips of his ears instantly turned red, and he turned away hastily: "No..."
The woman chuckled lightly, "Actually, don't get me wrong. Auntie, I am not just a casual woman."
"What happened to us earlier was mainly because my best friend had a bad heart and actually drugged me in the wine."
"Fortunately, I reacted quickly and happened to meet you for help, otherwise I would definitely fall into her hands today."
"So that's it, no wonder you..." Chen Yang couldn't help but glance at her secretly. The woman's facial features were as delicate as a fairy's, and her eyebrows were very similar to Liu Bingbing's.
But she is a bit more mature woman than Liu Bingbing.
Her skin is smooth and supple, and she looks like she is thirty years old.
No wonder Liu Bingbing and his girlfriend Liu Jiaojiao are both college beauties.
He would recognize the other person as Liu Bingbing's biological mother because of the phone call she answered half an hour ago.
At that time, the screen of her mobile phone lit up, and he glanced at it. The caller ID showed his daughter, and in the background was a photo of Liu Bingbing wearing a bachelor's uniform.
It was at the university graduation ceremony, and he and his girlfriend Liu Jiaojiao even went over to take a photo with Liu Bingbing.
At this time, Liu Aofei took out a wad of cash from her brand-name handbag and stuffed it directly into his arms: "Take this money. No third person must know about what happened today."
But Chen Yang immediately handed the money back as if he had been burned: "Auntie, I can't ask for your money. Don't worry, I will keep this in my stomach and will never tell anyone."
Although he comes from an ordinary family, he also knows not to randomly ask for other people's money.
Liu Aofei frowned and pushed the money over again: "If you don't accept it, I won't feel at ease. Just think of it as the driving fee I gave you."
She paused and added, "Send me back, my daughter will be here soon."
Chen Yang originally wanted to refuse, but he couldn't help but feel a little nervous when he heard this: "Will your daughter find this?"
"She installed a locator on my car. If she wants to find me, she can find me at any time."
"Then I'll take you back right now." Chen Yang broke into a cold sweat and hurriedly put on his seat belt.
If Liu Bingbing catches him and her mother in the car, maybe she will figure out something.
By then he would not be able to explain clearly even if he had a hundred mouths.
Liu Aofei reported an address and he drove out.
Half an hour later, the car drove into Fengming Residence.
